2225-captains-courageous-a-story-of-the-.description: A book by Rudyard Kipling. "Old man's piling up the rocks. 'Don't want to be disturbed, I guess. He'll find out his error a few years from now. 'Pity, because there's a heap of good in the boy if you could get at it."

75576-the-old-stanfield-house.title: The Sin Of Covetousness.
75576-the-old-stanfield-house.creator: Unknown
75576-the-old-stanfield-house.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ul in itself, being neither more nor less than an old family burying-ground, very full of gravestones, and with one tall monument towering over all. Now an old graveyard need not be a melancholy sight, provided that the grass be kept green, the stones whole, and the enclosure free from ugly weeds. That on which Calista was looking bore traces of utter neglect.

arxiv-2107-09816.title: Coupled embeddability Thanks: FF was supported by NSF grant DMS 1855591 and a Sloan Research Fellowship. MH was supported by Mathematisches Forschungsinstitut Oberwolfach with an Oberwolfach Leibniz Fellowship.
arxiv-2107-09816.creator: Florian Frick, Michael Harrison
arxiv-2107-09816.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Florian Frick, Michael Harrison. We introduce the notion of coupled embeddability, defined for maps on products of topological spaces. We use known results for nonsingular biskew and bilinear maps to generate simple examples and nonexamples of coupled embeddings. We study genericity properties for coupled embeddings of smooth manifolds, extend the Whitney embedding theorems to statements about coupled embeddability, and we discuss a Haefliger-type result for coupled embeddings.

arxiv-2201-04560.title: Pseudopotential Lattice Boltzmann Method for boiling heat transfer: a mesh refinement procedure
arxiv-2201-04560.creator: Alfredo Jaramillo, Vinícius Pessoa Mapelli, Luben Cabezas-Gómez
arxiv-2201-04560.description: Abstract Boiling is a complex phenomenon where different non-linear physical interactions take place and for which the quantitative modeling of the mechanism involved is not fully developed yet. In the last years, many works have been published focusing on the numerical analysis of this problem.

arxiv-2205-11980.title: Double copy of spontaneously broken Abelian gauge theory Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2205-11980.creator: Euro Spallucci, Anais Smailagic
arxiv-2205-11980.description: Abstract Similarity in the structure of scattering amplitudes in Yang-Mills theories and General Relativity led to the idea that graviton could be described as the double copy of a vector gauge field. In this letter we discuss a realization of this idea emerging directly from solutions of equations of General Relativity.

arxiv-2302-02414.title: Secure Codes with List Decoding Thanks: Y. Gu is with the Faculty of Information Science and Electrical Engineering, Kyushu University, Fukuoka, Japan. arxiv-2302-02414.creator: Yujie Gu, Ilya Vorobyev, Ying Miao
arxiv-2302-02414.description: Abstract In this paper we consider combinatorial secure codes in traitor tracing for protecting copyright of multimedia content. First, we introduce a new notion of secure codes with list decoding (SCLDs) for collusion-resistant multimedia fingerprinting, which includes many existing types of fingerprinting codes as special cases.

arxiv-2303-06635.title: Schema Inference for Interpretable Image Classification
arxiv-2303-06635.creator: Haofei Zhang, Mengqi Xue, Xiaokang Liu, Kaixuan Chen & Jie Song, Mingli Song
arxiv-2303-06635.description: Abstract In this paper, we study a novel inference paradigm, termed as schema inference , that learns to deductively infer the explainable predictions by rebuilding the prior deep neural network (DNN) forwarding scheme, guided by the prevalent philosophical cognitive concept of schema .

arxiv-2312-10731.title: From linear to nonlinear Breit-Wheeler pair production in laser-solid interactions
arxiv-2312-10731.creator: Huai-Hang Song, Wei-Min Wang, Min Chen, Zheng-Ming Sheng
arxiv-2312-10731.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Huai-Hang Song, Wei-Min Wang, Min Chen, Zheng-Ming Sheng. During the ultraintense laser interaction with solids (overdense plasmas), the competition between two possible quantum electrodynamics (QED) mechanisms responsible for e ± e^{\pm} pair production, i.e., linear and nonlinear Breit-Wheeler (BW) processes, remains to be studied. Here, we have implemented the linear BW process via a Monte Carlo algorithm into the QED particle-in-cell (PIC) code yunic , enabling us to self-consistently investigate both pair production mechanisms in the plasma environment.

arxiv-2410-13803.title: A Pattern to Align Them All: Integrating Different Modalities to Define Multi-Modal Entities
arxiv-2410-13803.creator: Gianluca Apriceno, Valentina Tamma, Tania Bailoni, Jacopo de Berardinis, Mauro Dragoni
arxiv-2410-13803.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gianluca Apriceno, Valentina Tamma, Tania Bailoni, Jacopo de Berardinis, Mauro Dragoni. The ability to reason with and integrate different sensory inputs is the foundation underpinning human intelligence and it is the reason for the growing interest in modelling multi-modal information within Knowledge Graphs. Multi-Modal Knowledge Graphs extend traditional Knowledge Graphs by associating an entity with its possible modal representations, including text, images, audio, and videos, all of which are used to convey the semantics of the entity.

arxiv-2411-19916.creator: Emma T. Chickles 1,2 ∗, Kevin B. Burdge 1,2, Joheen Chakraborty 1,2, Vik S. Dhillon 3,4, Paul Draghis 1,2, James Munday 5, Saul A. Rappaport 1,2, John Tonry 6, Evan Bauer 7, Alex J. Brown 8, Noel Castro 5, Deepto Chakrabarty 1,2, Martin Dyer 3, Kareem El-Badry 9, Anna Frebel 1,2, Gabor Furesz 1,2, J
arxiv-2411-19916.description: Abstract Type Ia supernovae, critical for studying cosmic expansion [ 1 ] , [ 2 ] , arise from thermonuclear explosions of white dwarfs [ 3 ] , but their precise progenitor pathways remain unclear. Growing evidence supports the “double-degenerate” scenario, where two white dwarfs interact [ 4 ] , [ 5 ] .

arxiv-2503-07469.title: Influence of finite-temperature effects on CMB power spectrum
arxiv-2503-07469.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . We explore the implications of finite-temperature quantum field theory effects on cosmological parameters within the framework of the Λ \Lambda CDM model and its modification. By incorporating temperature-dependent corrections to the cosmological constant, we extend the standard cosmological model to include additional density parameters, Ω Λ 2 \Omega_{\Lambda_{2}} and Ω Λ 3 \Omega_{\Lambda_{3}} , which arise from finite-T quantum gravitational effects.

arxiv-2506-19782.title: ’Mic drop’: on estimating the size of sub-mm droplets using a simple condenser microphone
arxiv-2506-19782.creator: Avshalom Offner
arxiv-2506-19782.description: Abstract The size distribution of aerosol droplets is a key parameter in a myriad of processes, and it is typically measured with optical aids (e.g., lasers or cameras) that require sophisticated calibration, thus making the measurement cost intensive. We developed a new method to indirectly measure the size of small droplets using off-the-shelf <$1 electret microphones.

arxiv-2507-21821.title: Tidal heating in detached double white dwarf binaries Wolfram Mathematica (https://www.wolfram.com/mathematica)

arxiv-2507-21821.description: Abstract Short–period ( P < P< 1 hr orbits) detached double white dwarf binary (DWDB) components identified with transient surveys (e.g. SDSS, ZTF) have hot surface temperatures ( > > 10,000 K) and observed radii a factor two larger than completely degenerate white dwarfs.

arxiv-2511-12163.title: Tight displacement-based formation control under bounded disturbances. A set-theoretic perspective.
arxiv-2511-12163.creator: Vlad-Matei Angheluţă, Bogdan Gheorghe, Daniel Ioan, Ionela Prodan, Florin Stoican
arxiv-2511-12163.description: Abstract This paper investigates the synthesis of controllers for displacement-based formation control in the presence of bounded disturbances, specifically focusing on uncertainties originating from measurement noise. While the literature frequently addresses such problems using stochastic frameworks, this work proposes a deterministic methodology grounded in set-theoretic concepts.

arxiv-2512-02208.title: Projective limits of probabilistic symmetries and their applications to random graph limits
arxiv-2512-02208.creator: Pim van der Hoorn, Huck Stepanyants, Dmitri Krioukov
arxiv-2512-02208.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pim van der Hoorn, Huck Stepanyants, Dmitri Krioukov. We couple projective limits of probability measures to direct limits of their symmetry groups. We show that the direct limit group is the group of symmetries of the projective limit probability measure.

pmc-10656607.title: Excessive daytime napping independently associated with decreased insulin sensitivity in cross-sectional study – Hyogo Sleep Cardio-Autonomic Atherosclerosis cohort study
pmc-10656607.creator: Miki Kakutani-Hatayama, Manabu Kadoya, Akiko Morimoto, Akio Miyoshi, Kae Kosaka-Hamamoto, Akinori Kanzaki, Kosuke Konishi, Yoshiki Kusunoki, Takuhito Syoji, Hidenori Koyama
pmc-10656607.description: BackgroundAlthough excessive daytime napping has been shown to be involved in diabetes occurrence, its impact on insulin secretion and sensitivity has not been elucidated. It is speculated that excessive napping disrupts the sleep-wake rhythm and increases sympathetic nerve activity during the day, resulting in decreased insulin sensitivity, which may be a mechanism leading to development of diabetes.

pmc-10742076.title: Morbidity of Transrectal MRI-Fusion Targeted Prostate Biopsy at a Tertiary Referral Academic Centre: An Audit to Guide the Transition to the Transperineal Approach

pmc-10742076.description: Simple SummaryThe choice between a transrectal or a transperineal approach for MRI-fusion-targeted prostate biopsy is still the subject of debate within the urologic community and across international Guidelines. Specifically, the European Association of Urology (EAU) guidelines recommend abandoning TRPB in favor of TPPB, due to lower rates of infection and sepsis.

pmc-10792323.title: Vortioxetine usage in an elderly patient with major depressive disorder and accompanied by multiple physical conditions: A case report
pmc-10792323.creator: Xiaoman Wang, Xiaoqian Ma, Yicheng Long, Guowei Wu
pmc-10792323.description: Elderly patients with depressive disorder always have complex and diverse symptoms, and are mostly combined with chronic physical conditions. This case report presents a case of vortioxetine usage in a 67‐year‐old male patient with major depressive disorder and accompanied by multiple physical conditions. INTRODUCTION In elderly people, depression mainly affects those with chronic physical diseases.

pmc-11325711.title: Long-term safety and influence on growth in patients receiving sirolimus: a pooled analysis

pmc-11325711.description: BackgroundSirolimus is increasingly utilized in treating diseases associated with mTOR pathway overactivation. Despite its potential, the lack of evidence regarding its long-term safety across all age groups, particularly in pediatric patients, has limited its further application. This study aims to assess the long-term safety of sirolimus, with a specific focus on its impact on growth patterns in pediatric patients.

pmc-11505812.description: Ubiquitination is one of the most important post-translational modifications in eukaryotes. The ubiquitination cascade includes ubiquitin-activating enzymes (E1), ubiquitin-conjugating enzymes (E2), and ubiquitin ligases (E3). The E3 ligases, responsible for substrate recognition, are the most abundant and varied proteins in the cascade and the most studied.

pmc-11653757.title: Antimicrobial Effects of Cannabidiol (CBD)-infused Lozenges against Streptococcus mutans in Oral Health

pmc-11653757.description: Cannabidiol presents several benefits, including but not limited to its analgesic, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, anti-pruritic, and anti-cancer properties. pmc-12650258.description: Sustainable adsorbents for industrial volatile organic compound (VOC) control are urgently needed to balance efficiency and operational economy. This report describes an eco-friendly strategy for fabricating hierarchical porous bentonite (Bt) via green ice-templating using lotus root starch as a biomass crosslinker. The optimized material exhibits a well-defined lamellar-bridging network with a specific surface area of 71.

pmc-13588000.title: A Functionally Conserved Enhancer is Critical for PGC1A Expression and Thermogenesis in Brown Fat
pmc-13588000.creator: Duo Su, Haosen Yang, Xiaokai Li, Tingting Jiang, Siyuan Zhan, Tao Zhong, Jiazhong Guo, Yan Wang, Li Li, Hongping Zhang, Linjie Wang
pmc-13588000.description: Brown adipose tissue (BAT) undergoes progressive age‐related involution into white adipose tissue (WAT), yet the epigenetic mechanisms underlying BAT whitening remain unclear. This study investigates the transcriptomic dynamics of goat perirenal adipose tissue (PRAT) across four postnatal stages and profiles active histone modifications and chromatin accessibility in PRAT at postnatal day 1 (BAT) and day 90 (WAT).

pmc-13616631.title: Sex-specific effects of automated feeding on lifespan and reproduction in Nothobranchius furzeri
pmc-13616631.creator: Luca Dolfi, Michael Kothmayer, Elmar Erwin Ebner, Renate Löhnert, Oliver Pusch
pmc-13616631.description: Introduction Nothobranchius furzeri, commonly known as African turquoise killifish, has emerged as a powerful model organism in diverse biological research areas owing to its exceptionally short lifespan of 4‐6 months. Dietary choices can significantly impact the physiology of this fish and its median longevity, prompting considerations on live versus dry food and feeding frequencies.
